description: This file contains a function `configFromStringAndArray` that attempts to parse a date/time configuration from an array of format strings, selecting the best match based on a scoring system. It uses various imported functions to assist with configuration copying, parsing, validation, and extension.

methods.name: configFromStringAndArray(config)
methods.description: Main function that takes a configuration object containing multiple format strings, attempts to parse each, scores them based on how well they fit the input, and extends the original configuration with the best matching parsed config.
